caption: The drawing depicts a detailed side view of a two-masted sailing ship set on a rectangular base that is painted to resemble green-blue water. The ship is predominantly black with a white horizontal stripe running along the hull near the waterline. The deck is gray, and the rigging consists of numerous fine black lines that represent ropes attached to the masts and spars. Both masts are tall and equipped with multiple yards and spars, though no sails are shown. There are two visible flags, one reddish-brown flag flying from the top of the rear mast, and another similar flag attached to the end of the yardarm extending to the left (aft) side of the ship. The bowsprit extends forward at an angle, also rigged with ropes. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery, keeping the focus entirely on the ship and its detailed rigging.
title: Model Brig
